subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should the durable-approvals work be rebuilt as a narrow current-main landing, or should maintainers intentionally accept and owner-review this 499-file reconciliation?
rationale: The core feature is valuable, but the branch mixes it with unrelated current-main reversions and recovery-contract regressions; selecting the acceptable landing vehicle and ownership burden requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebuild narrowly
options.body: Base a replacement head on current main, carry the approval stack and separately proven gate repairs, and preserve unrelated current-main behavior.

options.title: Review broad reconciliation
options.body: Keep this head only if owners for storage, updater, browser, UI, apps, gateway, plugins, and workflows accept the combined compatibility and security burden.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: Stop using this branch as a landing candidate if its intended approval work cannot be separated from the unrelated reversions.

recommendation.title: Rebuild narrowly
recommendation.body: Base a replacement head on current main, carry the approval stack and separately proven gate repairs, and preserve unrelated current-main behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person assembled the branch and owns the constituent approval-stack and updater history, making them the best available owner for choosing the landing vehicle.
